how: One shared (small-group) Viator wine tour per wine area, picked by hand from drafts/viator-2026-11/viator-products.csv (Viator Partner API, 2026-11-20): currently sold, well reviewed, pickup in that area. Each product page was checked live on viator.com on 2026-11-21. URLs are Viator's own productUrl with our pid (see viator.js). wine-tours.js shows one per page; it never changes ranking or which places show.

kelowna.label: Kelowna & West Kelowna
kelowna.title: Kelowna or West Kelowna Afternoon Sightseeing Wine Tour
kelowna.why: Most-reviewed wine tour in the area (4.9, 257 reviews); small group (max 11); pickup at your Kelowna or West Kelowna accommodation.

lake-country.label: Lake Country & Vernon
lake-country.title: Lake Country Half Day Wine Tour- Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Grat!
lake-country.why: Best-reviewed Lake Country tour (4.9, 54 reviews); small group (max 14); tasting fees included; pickup in Lake Country, Vernon, Coldstream and Sparkling Hill.

penticton.label: Penticton & Naramata
penticton.title: Naramata Full Day Lunch Wine Tour- Incl. Tasting Fees & Gratuity!
penticton.why: Top-rated Naramata Bench tour (5.0, 32 reviews); small group (max 14); tasting fees and lunch stop; pickup in the Penticton area.

summerland.label: Summerland
summerland.title: Summerland Full Day Lunch Wine Tour (Incl. Tasting Fees & Grat!)
summerland.why: The only shared small-group Summerland (Bottleneck Drive) tour with reviews (5.0, 3 reviews); same operator as the Naramata and Lake Country picks; pickup in the Summerland area.

oliver-osoyoos.label: Oliver & Osoyoos
oliver-osoyoos.title: Osoyoos Half Day Wine Tour (Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Gratuity!)
oliver-osoyoos.why: Most-reviewed South Okanagan tour (4.8, 74 reviews); small group (max 14); tasting fees included; pickup at your Osoyoos or Oliver accommodation.
